title: 이레즈미 풀 솔로 #012 · towering hourglass · American traditional eagle · 3/4 각도 · 검정 배경 · 글래스 스킨
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm bronze-brown complexion, late 20s goddess, towering hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily tall and curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a towering frame with legs that seem endless, thick smooth thighs and calves, hips wide and rounded, a sharply cinched narrow waist pulled in far tighter than her bust and hips, and a full heavy bust high on her chest; her height and long legs make every curve look longer and more dramatic; not stocky, not thin, not boyish; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, hair coloured warm auburn red-brown worn as tight zigzag crimped waves — full body American traditional eagle irezumi covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE. Bold black ink outlines — BLAZING DEEP BROWN eagle formations with spread wings and open beak across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID RED and YELLOW sunburst-ray detail filling every gap, NO airbrush NO gradient wash. Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip — most extreme towering hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, extreme platform wedges entirely in the exact same colours as her own body art — blazing deep brown, vivid red and yellow — NOT black, NOT dark, NOT plain — the footwear must be a bright, saturated, glossy colour taken straight from her own body art, each with a very tall razor-thin tapered heel and a hidden front platform, a natural relaxed stance with her weight settled on her feet.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, square nails each longer than her middle finger, painted in the same colours as her body art.
Jewelry: thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, and a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT painted — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Polynesian woman with a broad face, full lips and large dark eyes, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme: mirror-bright glass skin dripping with wet liquid shine, blinding liquid highlighter across the cheekbones, nose bridge, forehead and chin, a flushed dewy blush, mirror-gloss lips.

Background: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length EXTREME worm's-eye view shot with the camera placed on the floor at foot level and tilted steeply upward, the soles and heels huge in the foreground, her legs rising in exaggerated perspective and her head far above at the top of the frame, the whole figure from the soles of the shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so her extreme height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.

poses: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip
